topics.name: Agent Memory and Persistent State
topics.summary: These studies organize episodic traces, session context, and evolving workspaces so agents can retrieve relevant history without drowning in stale interactions. Their shared concern is preserving continuity while keeping state selective and inspectable.

topics.name: Tool-Using Agents and Workflow Automation
topics.summary: The papers build agents that coordinate tools, code, documents, transactions, or scientific workflows rather than answering in isolation. They emphasize delegation boundaries, execution traces, and recovery across interfaces.

topics.name: Agent Safety, Reliability, and Evaluation
topics.summary: These investigations test whether agent behavior remains safe, grounded, and accountable under failures, adversarial inputs, uncertain rewards, or changing protocols. Trace diagnostics and calibrated risk measures matter more than one aggregate score.

topics.name: Language Model Reasoning and Alignment
topics.summary: Language-model studies examine reasoning, preference optimization, prompting, multilingual transfer, and the gap between fluent answers and verified conclusions. They compare supervision, search, calibration, and representation-level interventions.

topics.name: Retrieval-Augmented and Knowledge Systems
topics.summary: Retrieval systems select evidence from documents, graphs, or long contexts before generating answers or structured outputs. The papers probe redundancy, hierarchy, grounding, and whether retrieved material improves faithful decisions.

topics.name: Efficient Inference and Model Compression
topics.summary: The collection reduces memory, latency, energy, or communication through quantization, pruning, distillation, caching, routing, and compact architectures. Results focus on deployment tradeoffs hidden by nominal accuracy.

topics.name: Generative Image and Video Modeling
topics.summary: Generative-vision work controls appearance, motion, layout, or identity with diffusion, flow matching, latent interventions, and multimodal conditioning. Evaluation balances local edit fidelity, temporal coherence, and creative variation.

topics.name: Visual Recognition and Dense Prediction
topics.summary: Perception papers learn detection, segmentation, classification, or anomaly representations under weak labels, domain shift, occlusion, and ambiguous boundaries. Multiscale features and uncertainty-aware objectives make visual decisions more reliable.

topics.name: 3D Vision, Geometry, and Spatial Understanding
topics.summary: These methods reconstruct geometry, estimate motion, or bind language to spatial structure using point clouds, splats, SLAM, depth, and scene graphs. They study consistency under sparse views, moving scenes, or incomplete observations.

topics.name: Medical Imaging and Clinical AI
topics.summary: Clinical models combine anatomical structure, multimodal scans, longitudinal records, and uncertainty estimates for diagnosis, triage, reconstruction, or procedural support. Limited labels and cross-device shift remain central deployment problems.

topics.name: Robotic Manipulation and Embodied Interaction
topics.summary: Embodied systems learn contact, dexterity, teleoperation, or assistive behavior from demonstrations, tactile sensing, and closed-loop feedback. Their common challenge is transferring policies into physically constrained interactions.

topics.name: Autonomous Driving, UAVs, and Traffic Safety
topics.summary: Vehicle and aerial-robot papers fuse perception, prediction, planning, and safety constraints for roads, airspace, or cooperative missions. Simulation and hardware-oriented tests expose how distribution shift changes collision risk.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning and Sequential Control
topics.summary: Decision-making studies shape policies with rewards, demonstrations, world models, bandit feedback, or constrained planning. They investigate exploration, credit assignment, and stability under delayed or partial dynamics.

topics.name: Time-Series Forecasting and Dynamical Models
topics.summary: Temporal modeling papers forecast evolving signals, detect regime changes, or estimate latent dynamics under missing data and nonstationarity. Adaptive context and physical structure replace assumptions of a fixed seasonal process.

topics.name: Graphs, Networks, and Relational Learning
topics.summary: Graph-based methods represent interactions, topology, or structured dependencies with message passing, spectral operators, and iterative inference. The papers examine temporal change, heterophily, influence, and communication limits.

topics.name: Statistical Learning, Causality, and Optimization Theory
topics.summary: Theoretical and statistical papers characterize identifiability, finite-sample error, causal transport, kernel behavior, optimization guarantees, and structured regression. Proofs and diagnostics clarify when shortcuts fail.

topics.name: Scientific Machine Learning and Computational Science
topics.summary: Scientific models join neural representations with physical laws, molecular structure, spectroscopy, fluids, materials, or biological mechanisms. Their value comes from constraints and extrapolation behavior, not narrow fit alone.

topics.name: Speech, Audio, and Computational Music
topics.summary: Audio studies model speech, vocal mixtures, musical structure, room acoustics, or paralinguistic cues with generative and source-separation techniques. Evaluation balances perceptual quality, identity preservation, and noisy overlap.

topics.name: Recommendation, Social Computing, and Human Behavior
topics.summary: These papers study ranking, exposure, polarization, advice, collaboration, and user responses through logs, audits, experiments, or human-centered evaluations. They ask whether aggregate utility hides unequal visibility or agency loss.

topics.name: AI Security, Provenance, and Adversarial Robustness
topics.summary: Security work evaluates poisoning, prompt attacks, deepfakes, watermarking, unlearning, model lineage, and privacy leakage across realistic delivery channels. Defenses are judged by transfer, false positives, and retained utility.

topics.name: Benchmarks, Audits, and Measurement Reliability
topics.summary: Benchmark and audit papers design tasks, datasets, rubrics, and protocols for capabilities or risks that headline scores compress. Their contribution is exposing leakage, disagreement, item regressions, or unreliable stopping rules.

topics.name: Structured Data, Operations, and Applied Prediction
topics.summary: Applied learning handles tabular records, spreadsheets, business processes, logistics, and operational demand with structured encoders or constrained optimization. Realistic missingness and capacity limits shape the decisions.

topics.name: Other Machine Learning Methods
topics.summary: These papers develop focused learning procedures or application-specific analyses that do not share enough structure with larger clusters. Their experiments or proofs still contribute reusable ideas about representation or model behavior.
